description: This file contains various utility functions, classes, and checks related to authentication and authorization mechanisms in the Litellm proxy server. It includes functions for managing user, team, organization, and object permissions; budget checks; route validations; cache management; and JWT/token utilities. The file plays a central role in enforcing access control policies for the API endpoints and inner operations.
